architecture.retired_generation_rule: Obsolete operational generations must remain absent after their unique useful capabilities are ported to V7 and the exact replacement is green and healthy in live-PAPER. Git history is the archive.
architecture.target: one slim canonical V7 PAPER codebase

current_priority_order: Keep one V7 runtime, one CRYPTO_SETTLEMENT_ENGINE, one global portfolio coordinator, one broker authority, one canonical execution ledger, one allocator, one risk guard and one monitoring plane.
Preserve live crypto market data, external feeds, execution lifecycle, fillability, markouts, queue, latency, settlement, replay and research evidence needed to improve crypto.
CRYPTO_SETTLEMENT_ENGINE compares professional maker, informed taker, cancellation and no-action components on one conservative account-wealth objective.
Delete non-crypto strategies, configs, adapters, runtime workers, monitoring surfaces and tests after crypto-useful shared capabilities are retained.
Keep training, backtests and retrospective research outside the London hot path; London owns collection, inference, risk, execution, reconciliation and minimal telemetry.
All proposals pass through one global portfolio coordinator, allocator, risk engine, OMS, inventory and ledger chain.
Keep technical readiness separate from economic readiness; exploitation capital requires mature causal forward evidence and positive conservative post-cost bounds.
Keep exact stage timestamps, persistent transport, exact-head p99/p99.9 guardrails and regional latency evidence without claiming venue latency from synthetic tests.
Continuously run repository-shape, crypto-only CI, monitoring and PAPER runtime smoke tests.

economic_objective.decision_ev: P(fill_or_joint_completion|X,a) * E[alpha_or_spread_capture-costs-adverse_markout|fill,X,a] - E[partial_or_inventory_unwind_loss|X,a] - capital_cost - latency_cost + conservatively_haircut_maker_rebate + conservatively_haircut_liquidity_reward
economic_objective.multi_leg_rule: Estimate the empirical joint completion/state distribution; product or minimum of marginal fill probabilities is not an accepted substitute.
economic_objective.success: positive forward realized PAPER fill-conditioned post-cost PnL with causal data, realistic simulated fills, authoritative fees, executable depth, inventory/unwind losses, markout, reward/rebate attribution, cost stress and no leakage

forbidden_regressions: Do not create V8/V9/V10 or another numerical runtime generation.
Do not create a second maker runtime, WebSocket market-data plane, state writer, broker owner, execution ledger or canonical integration.
Do not add or restore V3/V4/V5/V6 runtime logic or retired-generation wrappers.
Do not add authenticated or real-money execution.
Do not use product/minimum of marginal fill probabilities as a generic multi-leg joint completion estimator.

paper_v7_authorization.interpretation: 100% is a hard percentage ceiling, not a target. Finite $300 defense-in-depth guards remain configured even while the fixed-dollar switch is disabled. Kelly, executable depth, authoritative fees, spread/slippage, inventory and unwind risk, adverse markout, capital/latency costs, state integrity and the 15% drawdown kill switch still bind.

rule: V7 supports exactly CRYPTO_SETTLEMENT_ENGINE. Crypto-useful execution, data, evidence, replay, settlement, maker and monitoring capabilities remain; non-crypto algorithm families and their runtime baggage are removed. PAPER-only safety remains mandatory; authenticated_execution=false and real_order_submission=false.
